"""design_F872 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징·분할 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

WS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"; OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_F872.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
data_end = a.discharge_time.max()

# tp = 퇴원 시각
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a.discharge_time
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id").admit_time.shift(-1)

# 결과: 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a.next_admit > a.tp) & (a.next_admit <= a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
a["followup_censored"] = (a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30) > data_end) & (a.readmit_30d == 0)

# 코호트
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
c = c[c.age >= 18]
c = c[c.discharge_status != "died"].copy()

# 특징
win = lambda df, t: df.merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id").query(f"{t} >= admit_time and {t} <= tp")
L = win(labs, "report_time").sort_values("report_time")
c["hgb_min"] = c.admission_id.map(L[L.test == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id").value.min())
c["cr_last"] = c.admission_id.map(L[L.test == "creatinine"].groupby("admission_id").value.last())
O = win(orders, "order_time")
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c.admission_id.isin(O[O.order_type == "dialysis_order"].admission_id).astype(int)
c["los_h"] = (c.discharge_time - c.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 파생
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 이 시점 이전 입원 수 (전체 admissions 기준)
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.admission_id.map(a.assign(k=a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()).set_index("admission_id").k)
# 진단: 시각 정보가 없어 '해당(index) 입원'의 진단으로 한정 (설계서에 범위 미지정 → 확인 필요)
c["dx_ckd"] = c.admission_id.isin(dx[dx.icd_code.str.startswith("N18")].admission_id).astype(int)
c["dx_chf"] = c.admission_id.isin(dx[dx.icd_code.str.startswith("I50")].admission_id).astype(int)
c["n_dx"] = c.admission_id.map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

# 분할 그룹: family_id가 없으면 patient_id로 대체 (설계서 확인 필요)
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna(c.patient_id)
s = design["split"]
tr, te = next(GroupShuffleSplit(1, test_size=s["test_fraction"], random_state=s["seed"] % 2**32).split(c, groups=c.split_group))
c["split"] = "train"; c.iloc[te, c.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp", "readmit_30d", "followup_censored"] + feats
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_admissions_total": len(a), "n_cohort": len(c), "n_patients": c.patient_id.nunique(),
    "outcome_rate": round(c.readmit_30d.mean(), 4), "n_followup_censored": int(c.followup_censored.sum()),
    "split_counts": c.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "outcome_rate_by_split": c.groupby("split").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "group_overlap_train_test": len(set(c[c.split == "train"].split_group) & set(c[c.split == "test"].split_group)),
    "patient_overlap_train_test": len(set(c[c.split == "train"].patient_id) & set(c[c.split == "test"].patient_id)),
    "missing_rate": c[feats].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
E
